anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), which may indicate a bottleneck or excessive processing demand.
AI system shows no recent learning cycles, confidence, opportunities generated, or adjustments made, suggesting it may not be functioning correctly or is underutilized.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential system slowdowns or failures.

Evaluate trading strategies and execution processes to improve trade activity and profitability.
